# Any scope. D1 Admission of [country] enters into force for the members in global.cwop_ctx_part.
COLDWAR_OPEC_do_D1 = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: COLDWAR_OPEC D1 in force"
	var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_become_member = yes }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cwop_m_HM = 0.01 }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		add_to_array = { cwop_q6_item = cwop_t_eitem }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
		add_to_array = { cwop_q6_res = cwop_t_eres }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		add_to_array = { cwop_q6_target = cwop_t_etarget }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
		add_to_array = { cwop_q6_val = cwop_t_eval }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev6_busy } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev6_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.6 }
		}
	}
	mdcw_cw_update_opec_share = yes

}

# Any scope. The item of the file in the context enters into force for its bound members.
COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_apply = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_share = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_ctx_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_share = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwop_ctx_share min = 0 max = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 11 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_A1 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 12 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_A2 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 13 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_A3 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 14 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_A4 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 15 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_A5 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 16 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_A6 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 17 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_A7 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 18 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_A8 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 21 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_B1 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 22 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_B2 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 23 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_B3 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 24 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_B4 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 31 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_C1 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 32 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_C2 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 33 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_C3 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 41 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_D1 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 42 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_D2 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 43 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_D3 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 44 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_D4 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 45 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_D5 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 47 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_D7 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 48 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_D8 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 49 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_D9 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 50 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_F1 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 51 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_E1 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 52 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_E2 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 53 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_E3 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 54 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_E4 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 55 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_E5 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 56 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_E6 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 57 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_E7 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 58 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_do_E8 = yes
	}
	mdcw_cw_update_world_situation = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_ctx_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_market_values = yes
}

# Country scope. Co-operation outside OPEC (Mexico 1986, Norway 1987): joins the running agreement, quotas and cuts.
COLDWAR_OPEC_cooperate = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_watch = yes
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_cooperating
	# it joins the price agreement, the quotas and the cuts that run
	if = {
		limit = { any_of_scopes = { array = global.cwop_members has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_agreement } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_agreement days = 730 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_quota_end > 0 }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_quota value = THIS } } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_quota = THIS }
		set_variable = { cwop_q_EX = -0.08 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage > 0 }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_cutters value = THIS } } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_cutters = THIS }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_cut_values = yes
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = { array = global.cwop_members add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_op_cooperation } }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_line } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_line }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
	mdcw_cw_update_opec_share = yes
}

# Country scope (player). Joins the resolution cwop_x_item in force (E1: joint embargo cwop_x_rec).
COLDWAR_OPEC_join_item = {
	# a player joins a resolution in force later (associate, observer, co-operating producer, or a member that reserved): full price, gain from now
	COLDWAR_OPEC_watch = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_line } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_line }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_item = 12 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_agreement days = 730 value = 1 }
		clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_cut
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_item = 21 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_supply_restraint days = 180 value = 1 }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_OPEC_t_B1 days = 180 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_item = 22 } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_quota = THIS }
		set_variable = { cwop_q_EX = -0.08 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_item = 31 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_m_EX = 0.04 }
		set_variable = { cwop_c1_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_c1_day = 1095 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_participation
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.005 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_item = 33 } }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_m_EX = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { cwop_m_ST = 0.02 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ownership
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.003 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_item = 52 } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_cutters = THIS }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_cut_values = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_item = 51 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_rec = 1 } }
			add_to_array = { global.cwop_e1_src = THIS }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_e1_tg
				if = { limit = { exists = yes } PREV = { COLDWAR_OPEC_pair_start = yes } }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_rec = 2 } }
			add_to_array = { global.cwop_e2_src = THIS }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_e2_tg
				if = { limit = { exists = yes } PREV = { COLDWAR_OPEC_pair_start = yes } }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_rec = 3 } }
			add_to_array = { global.cwop_e3_src = THIS }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_e3_tg
				if = { limit = { exists = yes } PREV = { COLDWAR_OPEC_pair_start = yes } }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_rec = 4 } }
			add_to_array = { global.cwop_e4_src = THIS }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_e4_tg
				if = { limit = { exists = yes } PREV = { COLDWAR_OPEC_pair_start = yes } }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
	mdcw_cw_update_opec_share = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Country scope (an objector, Art. 11). Leaves the obligation of an item that is already in force.
COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_unbind = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 12 } }
		clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_agreement
		mdcw_cw_update_opec_share = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 21 } }
		clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_supply_restraint
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_OPEC_t_B1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_OPEC_t_B1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 52 } }
		remove_from_array = { global.cwop_cutters = THIS }
		set_variable = { cwop_c_EX = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 55 } }
		remove_from_array = { global.cwop_noleak = THIS }
		set_variable = { cwop_l_EX = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 58 } }
		remove_from_array = { global.cwop_k_payers = THIS }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 51 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 54 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e1_src value = THIS } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_end_source = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e2_src value = THIS } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e2_end_source = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e3_src value = THIS } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e3_end_source = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e4_src value = THIS } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e4_end_source = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
	}
}
